points.description: Names at least two relevant appearance/shape features useful for classifying roads, such as road width, colour/texture of the road surface, or edges (edge detection). Equivalent valid features earn credit.
points.partial_credit: Half (0.5) if only one such feature is named.

points.description: Names at least one structural/contextual feature, such as road length between junctions/dead ends, or road edges/shadows used to identify bridges and flyovers. Equivalent valid features earn credit.
